title: Same code working on one instance but not on other with identical setup
description: Two instances with nearly identical setup and configuration showed divergent behavior. Code was working on one instance but failing on another, despite both instances appearing to have the same configuration.

evidence.failing_instance: Instance B - same code failing to execute

root_cause.cause: File skipped during upgrade process on failing instance
root_cause.issue: Instance-level code divergence - critical file missing from deployment
root_cause.impact: Code execution failure due to missing upgrade file
root_cause.fix_applied: Deployed missing file to failing instance
root_cause.result: Code now working consistently across both instances

lesson_learned: Instance-level code parity is critical - verify all files are included during upgrades. Identical config does not guarantee identical code state.
